sn12.20:1.2: Dependent origination is the process, the dependently originated phenomena are the product.
sn12.20:2.3: Note That BB’s note here says that the identical passage is found at AN 3.136, but there idapaccayata is omitted.
sn12.20:3.17: This phrase is also at [sn12.1:2.14](). Note that there is no corresponding “dependent cessation”. The ending of dependent origination is Nibbana, extinguishment.
